recipe:
set -e
x=$(mktemp -d) && tar xzf results/submitted/data_vectors/xi_scan/xi_sweep_bundle.tar.gz -C $x
c=$(mktemp -d) && tar xzf results/submitted/covariances/cov_scan/cov_sweep_bundle.tar.gz -C $c
l=$(mktemp -d) && tar xzf results/submitted/data_vectors/cl_scan/cl_sweep_bundle.tar.gz -C $l
k=$(mktemp -d) && tar xzf results/submitted/covariances/cl_cov_scan/cl_cov_sweep_bundle.tar.gz -C $k
ver=$(python src/papers/bmodes/scripts/catalog_versions.py size_cut applied --scan-version SP_v1.4.8_leak_corr --fine-grid)
cb=covariance_"$ver"_A_integration
nb=$(python src/workflow/scripts/decision_values.py harmonic_validation_binning bins_96)
python src/papers/bmodes/scripts/harmonic_config_cosebis_comparison.py \
  --fiducial-catalog size_cut --leakage-correction applied --reporting-binning bins_20 --integration-grid bins_1000 --mode-count n_max_20 \
  --blind blind_a \
  --fiducial-version $ver \
  --harmonic-validation-binning bins_96 \
  --fiducial-cl-path "$l/cl_$ver"_blind=A_powspace_nbins=$nb.fits \
  --fiducial-cl-cov-path "$k/cl_cov_$ver"_blind=A_powspace_nbins=$nb.fits \
  --fiducial-xi-path "$x/$ver"_xi_minsep=0.5_maxsep=300.0_nbins=1000_npatch=1.txt \
  --fiducial-cov-path "$c/$cb/$cb"_processed.txt \
  --out-file results/submitted/validation/cosebis_harmonic_scan/harmonic_modes_sp_v1p4p8.npz
rm -rf "$x" "$c" "$l" "$k"
